title: Good Jobs for ITE and Polytechnic Graduates in Light of Economic Slowdown
what_it_is: Good Jobs for ITE and Polytechnic Graduates in Light of Economic Slowdown

sections.label: Graduate employment within six months
sections.summary: In 2018, around nine in 10 graduates entering the labour market were employed within six months after final examinations, a figure stable for 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In 2018, around nine in 10 graduates who entered the labour market were employed within six months after their final examinations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: This figure has remained stable for the past 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding economic headwinds, overall employment has continued to grow and job vacancies remain available for ITE and polytechnic graduates.

sections.label: SkillsFuture Work-Study and Career Starter
sections.summary: SkillsFuture Work-Study programmes are offered for Diplomas and Post-Diplomas, and WSG rolled out the Career Starter Programme in January this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In addition, we offer SkillsFuture Work-Study programmes for Diplomas and Post-Diplomas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In January this year, Workforce Singapore (WSG) rolled out the Career Starter Programme, comprising workshops and personalised coaching to help both graduating ITE and polytechnic students and fresh graduates boost their job search skills and be more employable.

sections.label: Labour market monitoring for graduates
sections.summary: Advance third-quarter labour market data indicate employment continued to grow in sectors such as Professional Services and Community, Social and Personal Services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Although businesses are facing greater uncertainty, the advance third-quarter labour market data indicate that employment continued to grow in sectors, such as Professional Services and Community, Social and Personal Services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: MOM and MOE are monitoring the labour market closely and will ensure ITE and polytechnic graduates are well supported in their job search.
